title: Virus
problem: The base matches the text (2 x one Poison tick). Extra Poison ticks (Chronic Illness, Strangulation) and the Diagnosis cap aren't counted (hidden).
notes: Text: Virus: "Enemies take damage equal to 2 turns of their {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_POISON} debuff." | Moonstone: "Damage Increased By {1}%" | Codex: "If a Spell Gem doesn't work with a ... Evidence: bc_CreatureCast L17464-L17466 @0x140a0a126 (bc_CalculatePoisonDamage x 2 -> bc_EventDamage, dtype 1). Compat column 10 = 1 (DAMAGE tag); Moonstone only in bc_SpellDamage @0x14163dfea. Fix sketch: Same as B3#26 (fixed-amount family record). Reasoning: The amount itself is as written; the bug is the offered-but-dead gem properties (codex + property text). Ship in the family record with #26. App note (unpatched game): Virus deals 2x one Poison tick; it can crit and damage-taken bonuses apply, but spell-damage bonuses and damage / potency gem properties don't. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26).
